description: DP-02 Streaming | Em que intervalo horário é mais vantajoso vender energia renovável? | Gold: dp_energy_market_api_hourly | Qualidade · Contrato · ML

panels.title: 📊 KPIs Executivos — Em que hora é mais vantajoso vender energia renovável?

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(market_price_pt), 2) AS "Preço Médio" FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_utc)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(consumo_total), 0) AS "Consumo Médio" FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_utc)
SELECT hora AS "Melhor Hora" FROM (  SELECT hora, AVG(market_price_pt) AS avg_p FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly GROUP BY hora ORDER BY avg_p DESC LIMIT 1) t

panels.title: 🏆 Melhor Hora para Venda (UTC — histórico completo)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(MAX(market_price_pt), 2) AS "Pico Preço" FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_utc)

WITH h AS (  SELECT hora, AVG(market_price_pt) AS ap, AVG(consumo_total) AS ac FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly GROUP BY hora), m AS (SELECT MAX(ap) AS mp, MAX(ac) AS mc FROM h) SELECT ROUND(MAX((h.ap/m.mp - h.ac/m.mc)*100), 1) AS "Índice Máx (%)" FROM h, m
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN market_price_pt < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Preços Negativos" FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_utc)
SELECT CAST(date_diff('hour', MAX(ts_utc), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) AS "Freshness (h)" FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly
SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE)*100.0 / NULLIF(date_diff('hour', MIN(ts_utc), MAX(ts_utc)) + 1, 0), 1) AS "Taxa Join (%)" FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly

panels.title: 🔗 Taxa de Join Consumo × Preço (%) — SLO >= 98%

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE  WHEN date_diff('hour', MAX(ts_utc), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) > 4 THEN 'FAIL'  WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN market_price_pt < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0    OR date_diff('hour', MAX(ts_utc), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) > 2 THEN 'WARN'  ELSE 'OK' END AS "Estado" FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly

panels.title: 🟢 Estado Global do Contrato — OK / WARN / FAIL
🎯 Decision Analytics — Quando & Porquê Vender Energia Renovável

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts_utc AS "time", ROUND(market_price_pt, 2) AS "Preço PT (€/MWh)", ROUND(consumo_total, 1) AS "Consumo (MWh)" FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_utc) ORDER BY ts_utc

panels.title: Série Temporal — Preço Day-Ahead PT (€/MWh) & Consumo (MWh)

targets.rawSql: SELECT hora AS "Hora (UTC)", ROUND(AVG(market_price_pt), 2) AS "Preço Médio (€/MWh)" FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly GROUP BY hora ORDER BY hora

panels.title: 📊 Preço Médio Day-Ahead por Hora do Dia (0–23 UTC)

targets.rawSql: WITH h AS (  SELECT hora, AVG(market_price_pt) AS ap, AVG(consumo_total) AS ac  FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly WHERE market_price_pt IS NOT NULL AND consumo_total IS NOT NULL GROUP BY hora), m AS (SELECT MAX(ap) AS mp, MAX(ac) AS mc FROM h) SELECT h.hora AS "Hora (UTC)", ROUND((h.ap/m.mp - h.ac/m.mc)*100, 1) AS "Índice Oportunidade (%)" FROM h, m ORDER BY "Índice Oportunidade (%)" DESC

panels.title: 🏆 Índice de Oportunidade de Venda por Hora (melhor → pior)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(consumo_total, 0) AS "Consumo (MWh)", ROUND(market_price_pt, 2) AS "Preço PT (€/MWh)" FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_utc) AND consumo_total IS NOT NULL AND market_price_pt IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts_utc LIMIT 5000

panels.title: 🔵 Scatter: Consumo (MWh) vs Preço Day-Ahead PT (€/MWh) — Correlação

targets.rawSql: SELECT hora AS "Hora", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN dia_semana=0 THEN market_price_pt END), 1) AS "Seg", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN dia_semana=1 THEN market_price_pt END), 1) AS "Ter", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN dia_semana=2 THEN market_price_pt END), 1) AS "Qua", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN dia_semana=3 THEN market_price_pt END), 1) AS "Qui", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN dia_semana=4 THEN market_price_pt END), 1) AS "Sex", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN dia_semana=5 THEN market_price_pt END), 1) AS "Sab", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN dia_semana=6 THEN market_price_pt END), 1) AS "Dom" FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly GROUP BY hora ORDER BY hora

panels.title: 🌡️ Heatmap: Preço Médio (€/MWh) por Hora × Dia da Semana

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts_utc AS "time", ROUND(rolling_avg_price_24h, 2) AS "Preço Médio Móvel 24h (€/MWh)", ROUND(rolling_avg_consumo_24h, 0) AS "Consumo Médio Móvel 24h (MWh)" FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_utc) AND rolling_avg_price_24h IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts_utc

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', ts_utc) AS "time", ROUND(AVG(market_price_pt), 2) AS "Preço Médio Mensal (€/MWh)", ROUND(SUM(consumo_total), 0) AS "Consumo Total Mensal (MWh)" FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', ts_utc) ORDER BY 1

🔍 Contrato & Observabilidade — Evidência de Qualidade (SLOs · Quality Gates · contract.yaml)

targets.rawSql: SELECT (COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT ts_utc)) AS "Duplicados" FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Registos" FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN consumo_total IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Nulos consumo" FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN market_price_pt IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Nulos preço" FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN hora NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 23 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Hora Inválida" FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN dia_semana NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Dia Inválido" FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN market_price_pt < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Preços Negativos" FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly
SELECT CAST(date_diff('hour', MAX(ts_utc), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) AS "Freshness (h)" FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly
SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE)*100.0 / NULLIF(date_diff('hour', MIN(ts_utc), MAX(ts_utc)) + 1, 0), 1) AS "Taxa Join (%)" FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Lag Incons." FROM (   SELECT ABS(consumo_lag_1h - LAG(consumo_total,1) OVER (ORDER BY ts_utc)) AS diff   FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly WHERE consumo_lag_1h IS NOT NULL ) t WHERE diff > 0.001

SELECT CASE  WHEN date_diff('hour', MAX(ts_utc), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) > 4 THEN 'FAIL'  WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN market_price_pt < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0    OR date_diff('hour', MAX(ts_utc), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) > 2 THEN 'WARN'  ELSE 'OK' END AS "Estado" FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly

panels.title: 🟢 Estado QC Global — OK / WARN / FAIL

targets.rawSql: SELECT qc_id AS "ID", check_name AS "Regra", resultado AS "Estado", valor AS "Valor", slo AS "SLO" FROM (  SELECT 'QC-G01' AS qc_id, 'Unicidade ts_utc' AS check_name,    CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=COUNT(DISTINCT ts_utc) THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS resultado,    CAST(COUNT(*)-COUNT(DISTINCT ts_utc) AS VARCHAR)||' dup' AS valor, '0 dup' AS slo  FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly  UNION ALL SELECT 'QC-G02','Null consumo_total',    CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN consumo_total IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0 THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END,    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN consumo_total IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS VARCHAR)||' nulos','0 nulos'  FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly  UNION ALL SELECT 'QC-G03','Null market_price_pt',    CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN market_price_pt IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0 THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END,    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN market_price_pt IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS VARCHAR)||' nulos','0 nulos'  FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly  UNION ALL SELECT 'QC-G05','Hora BETWEEN 0 AND 23',    CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN hora NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 23 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0 THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END,    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN hora NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 23 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS VARCHAR)||' viol.','0 viol.'  FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly  UNION ALL SELECT 'QC-G06','Dia semana BETWEEN 0 AND 6',    CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN dia_semana NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0 THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END,    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN dia_semana NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS VARCHAR)||' viol.','0 viol.'  FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly  UNION ALL SELECT 'QC-G09','Precos Negativos (WARN)',    CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN market_price_pt<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0 THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'WARN' END,    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN market_price_pt<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS VARCHAR)||' horas','validos MIBEL'  FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly  UNION ALL SELECT 'SLO-F1','Freshness <= 4h',    CASE WHEN date_diff('hour',MAX(ts_utc),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)<=4 THEN 'PASS'         WHEN date_diff('hour',MAX(ts_utc),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)<=8 THEN 'WARN' ELSE 'FAIL' END,    CAST(date_diff('hour',MAX(ts_utc),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS VARCHAR)||'h atraso','< 4h'  FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly  UNION ALL SELECT 'SLO-J1','Taxa Join >= 98%',    CASE WHEN ROUND(CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE)*100.0/NULLIF(date_diff('hour',MIN(ts_utc),MAX(ts_utc))+1,0),1)>=98         THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'WARN' END,    CAST(ROUND(CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE)*100.0/NULLIF(date_diff('hour',MIN(ts_utc),MAX(ts_utc))+1,0),1) AS VARCHAR)||'%','>= 98%'  FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly) t ORDER BY qc_id
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Exemplos" FROM iceberg.gold.feat_load_forecasting_api_hourly
SELECT ROUND(AVG(consumo_next_hour), 0) AS "Target Médio" FROM iceberg.gold.feat_load_forecasting_api_hourly

## Modelo ML — preco_consumo_load_forecaster

| Propriedade | Valor |
|---|---|
| **Algoritmo** | GradientBoostingRegressor |
| **Tarefa** | Regressão — prever `consumo_next_hour` (MWh) |
| **Feature table** | `iceberg.gold.feat_load_forecasting_api_hourly` |
| **Experimento MLflow** | `preco-consumo-streaming-forecasting` |
| **R²** | 0.989 |
| **MAPE** | 1.30% |

> **Features:** `hora`, `dia_semana`, `is_weekend`, `consumo_lag_1h`, `consumo_lag_24h`, `price_lag_1h`, `rolling_avg_consumo_24h`, `rolling_avg_price_24h`, `market_price_pt`

> **Semântica:** `ts_utc` sempre UTC; preços negativos são WARN, não erro; INNER JOIN garante que só entram horas com consumo e preço disponíveis.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts_utc AS "time", ROUND(consumo_total, 1) AS "Consumo Atual (MWh)", ROUND(consumo_next_hour, 1) AS "Target: Próxima Hora (MWh)" FROM iceberg.gold.feat_load_forecasting_api_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_utc) ORDER BY ts_utc
